task.title: Inputting a renewal week with an Operational Centre Memo (MM06)

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No or 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.

Work item:
If it is an active or not blocked claim, select 92 - Purge and Recreate.
If it is a blocked, archived or MPS claim, or a claim with a BPC older than the current week – 150, select 93 - Manual Pay System .

Work type:
If 92 - Purge and Recreate was selected in the Work item field, select 26 - Processing of a report blocked by a renewal week .
If 93 - Manual Pay System was selected in the Work item field, select 33 – Blocked claim requiring payment .
Remarks line 1: Type “Antedate renewal from w/c [XXXX] to w/c [XXXX].”
Remarks line 2 to 4: Enter the claimant’s report details and any allocation information.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Detection: Select 23 - Recalculation - postdating or antedating .
Infraction: Select C - Non-fraud - Insurability - new information .
Message: Select 38 - An overpayment resulted due to a change in the start of your claim .
Contentious: Select 1 - No or 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 04 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: If there is an outstanding WI for the antedate request, complete it.
